topic: Paying the card after the due date vs paying before the statement closes to lower reported utilization (Kelvin vs Heidi)

scenes.narration: Your credit score reads your balance on statement day, not payday. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic pointing at a calendar with STATEMENT DAY circled beside a credit score meter, comic burst banner reads STATEMENT DAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kelvin and Heidi both spend two thousand a month on a five thousand limit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man kelvin and woman heidi each holding a card statement reading LIMIT FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both pay in full every month. Neither ever pays interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two statements stamped PAID IN FULL, a tag reads INTEREST ZERO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kelvin pays on the due date, three weeks after the statement closes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man kelvin paying on a calendar date labeled DUE DATE, the statement date three weeks earlier, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bureau sees a two thousand dollar balance, forty percent utilization.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit report line reading BALANCE TWO THOUSAND, UTILIZATION FORTY PERCENT, a yellow warning, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His score sits at six hundred ninety. Fine, but not great.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a score meter needle at SIX NINETY in the yellow zone, man kelvin shrugging, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He applies for a mortgage and gets a higher rate tier.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man kelvin at a lender desk, a rate sheet shows his tier one step below the best, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Heidi pays most of her balance two days before the statement closes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman heidi paying on a calendar date two days before STATEMENT DAY, a check mark, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bureau sees a two hundred dollar balance, four percent utilization.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit report line reading BALANCE TWO HUNDRED, UTILIZATION FOUR PERCENT, a green check, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her score reads seven hundred sixty with the exact same spending.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a score meter needle at SEVEN SIXTY in the green zone, woman heidi smiling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her mortgage rate is a quarter point lower. That is eighteen thousand over thirty years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a mortgage chart comparing two rates, a tag reads EIGHTEEN THOUSAND SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pay before the statement closes, not by the due date. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading PAY BEFORE STATEMENT DAY, a healthy score chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
